AdminKeyStore
Loads the Administrator's ML-DSA signing key pair from disk on every run, generating and persisting it once on first run.
CertDao
Interface representing the Data Access Object (DAO) for Certificate Records.

MySQL implementation of the certificate records DAO, against the pre-existing certs table (columns cert_ind/user_id/cert_pem; see sql/pending_certs.sql and CLAUDE.md for the full schema).
DaoSupport
Optional transaction boundary for database adapters that need an entire MTC build round to be atomic.
DaoSupport.TxAction<T>
A unit of work to be run by DaoSupport.inTransaction(TxAction).
JdbiTransactionSupport
Shared helper that lets a series of otherwise independent JDBI calls on the same Jdbi instance participate in a single database transaction, without changing the calling code's method signatures.
MLDSA
Main class for handling Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) operations.
